newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Explosion rips through Israeli military plant.
newsitem.headline: Explosion rips through Israeli military plant.

text.p: An explosion tore through an Israeli Military Industries plant near Tel Aviv on Sunday, injuring at least one person and causing a fire, Army Radio said.
The radio said it appeared the explosion in the town of Beer Yaakov was an industrial accident and several people were trapped under debris.
In another report from the scene, Israel Radio said black smoke billowed over the Beer Yaakov plant and at least one person had been hurt.
Ambulance sirens could be heard in the background as the radio's correspondent reported from outside the factory.
Israel has been on high alert for suicide bombings by Moslem militants since an attack on March 21 in a Tel Aviv cafe killed three Israeli women.
Israeli Military Industries is the country's largest ammunition maker and accidental explosions have occurred at some of its facilities in the past.
